triage_note: DEGRADED, but mostly by definition rather than by breakage. One source genuinely failed (the Good Judgment feed returned 403; it verified that morning, so its bot shield is intermittent). Most of the other 'thin' results come from a mismatch introduced the same day: the six new forecasting-methods sources were given expect_min values equal to the size of each WHOLE feed, while scouts count only items inside the week's window, and the GitHub releases entries count a repo with no release this week as thin. Those sources will read thin every week however healthy they are, which is the permanently-red-check failure contracts.py warns about; it is carried as an OPEN debt rather than quietly redefined. Separately, all five of W37's WATCHING items had their recorded tripwires fire during this week's work; they are listed in tripwires_fired and returned for decision, which is the only legitimate route back for a parked item. Every promoted item was re-read and verified before promotion.

promoted.title: Fabrication After Tool Failure: Tool-Augmented Agents Assert Values Their Tools Did Not Return
promoted.verified: title and abstract fetched from arxiv.org/abs/2609.14758 on 2026-09-15 and matched
promoted.why: This week's research slate runs seven agents that each report a primary number from a tool's output. The paper measures 14.10% of responses asserting a value the tool payload could not support under a deployment-style prompt. This session already produced one instance: a council lens reported a test count it had not observed, caught only because the chair re-ran the suite. The practical consequence is that every arm's primary endpoint should be machine-extracted from paired.json, never transcribed.

promoted.title: From Experiments to Decisions: Reusing Evidence in Autonomous Coding Research
promoted.verified: title and abstract fetched from arxiv.org/abs/2609.13299 on 2026-09-15 and matched
promoted.why: Documents agents carrying forward conclusions an experiment does not justify, including a coordinator that acknowledges a novelty-only rejection and then summarises it as measured closure. That is the exact failure mode waiting for the orchestrator when it consolidates seven arm results into one report. It argues for stating each arm's evidence tier separately and never letting the summary outrank its inputs.
